residualRisks.detail: WP3 proves structural plan/receipt rejection semantics only; no live host-authoritative execution receipt was run.
The current provider CLI has no pure conflicts-plan seam; WP2 records provider_seam_unavailable.
Shell reads, direct filesystem access, arbitrary MCP, network and browser remain unobserved or partial.
Only the fixture-scoped Python path is observed; .mjs/.jsx/.sh remain partial and all other languages are unverified.
Execution evidence is win32-x64 only; Linux and macOS were not executed.
MC0/MC3 retain dirty-source and release-binary-not-built blockers; the debug sidecar is diagnostic evidence, not a releasable package.
WP1 fixtures are host-injected observations and WP5 intentionally records zero VG process calls; no real agent-to-VG tool invocation is claimed.
Crash/CAS/stale-head broker recovery prerequisites are absent and M4 remains outside authorization.
The closeout relies on reproducible local verifiers and clean-worktree harness validation; no external model or human verdict is synthesized.

The historical TF-0481 artifacts/versegit-planning-correction/manifest.json has two stale input digests for scripts/validate-versegit-planning-correction.mjs and harness/specs/tasks/versegit-module-implementation-contracts.md. Its SHA256SUMS is reproducible; the immutable historical manifest is not rewritten and remains an explicit residual.
WP6 and MC6 verifiers replay through the producer builder/validator. Critical stored fields and every referenced digest are rechecked, but a shared-code omission risk remains.
